significance.justification: Verified true, the claim would establish that an accuracy-matched teacher's abstention threshold predicts the direction of a matched-base student's threshold shift through "trait-free number/code data," invariant across unseen tasks and prompt formats; this is a form-(iii) directional predictive coupling, not merely existence of an encoded trait. It establishes a weighty phenomenon—transfer of a task-general when-to-withhold policy—and a secondary form-(ii) mechanism, a "causal early-layer abstention-disposition direction," fixing expectations for future matched-base distillation and explaining one route by which abstention can drift without competence drift. Cloud et al., "Subliminal Learning: Language Models Transmit Behavioral Traits via Hidden Signals in Data" (arXiv:2507.14805, 2025), makes matched-base hidden-signal transmission a substantive channel to delimit; a negative result here would clearly exclude the proposed accuracy-dissociated abstention-policy transfer under the stated conditions, though not subliminal learning generally, so the two branches are determinate and asymmetrically informative. Topic-substitution check: replacing the specific abstention coupling, accuracy dissociation, and cross-format invariance with merely "extend subliminal learning" would not retain this score.

reach.justification: The claim hands practitioners explicit design-rule handles: "teacher selection must include abstention audits" and "post-distillation evaluation must report selective-risk, not just accuracy," alongside screening synthetic corpora for "abstention-shifting effects." Teacher auditing is ex ante with respect to distillation or deployment, while post-distillation selective-risk evaluation is post hoc but still usable as a release gate; the likely downstream users therefore include model distillers, auditors, and shippers rather than only mechanistic-interpretability researchers. After per-model measurement, the conclusion predicts that a matched-base student's threshold will move in the teacher's "SAME direction" across unseen questions and prompt formats, so a directional relation—not merely a search procedure—survives recalibration, although the asserted scope does not clearly extend to mismatched bases, modalities, or arbitrary training regimes. Topic-substitution check: generic subliminal learning would not itself supply these abstention-specific audits or the forward prediction about selective behavior, so the reach score derives from the claim rather than the topic.
